person.name: Prajwal Wankhade
person.tagline: Software Development Engineer with experience building scalable backend systems, data pipelines, and user‑centric products.
about: I am a Software Engineer with a B.Tech in Information Technology from Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar (NIT Jalandhar). I enjoy designing and building reliable systems that solve real problems for users at scale.

At Roundglass Foundation, I’ve worked across backend, auth, and analytics — from designing data collection platforms used by hundreds of daily users to integrating services with BI tools for real‑time reporting. Previously, at GKMT, I contributed to microservices‑based applications, fixing bugs and shipping dashboards that made internal teams more productive.

I’m particularly interested in backend engineering, distributed systems, and developer tooling — with hands‑on experience in Node.js, Express, MongoDB, SQL, and cloud services like AWS S3. I like working in collaborative, iterative environments where code quality, clear communication, and impact matter.
Beyond work, I enjoy experimenting with side projects, exploring new frameworks, and continuously improving my understanding of system design and performance.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
experience.description: Working as a Software Development Engineer on data‑driven products, authentication, and integrations for reporting and analytics.
highlights: Designed and deployed a dynamic form‑based data collection system used by 900+ daily users, enabling real‑time backend synchronization and analytics that reduced manual data processing by ~60%.
Led migration to FusionAuth, strengthening authentication security and reducing auth‑related failures.
Integrated new features into CI/CD pipelines to increase deployment consistency and reduce release issues by ~20%.
Integrated backend services with Power BI for live reporting, using Firebase Functions and NocoDB (SQL) to manage and serve data pipelines.
Collaborated in Agile sprints with designers, backend engineers, and product teams using Git workflows and code reviews to deliver features iteratively.

experience.title: Software Developer Intern
experience.description: Software development intern working on microservices‑based applications, dashboards, and cross‑platform UI.
highlights: Solved different types of bugs and progressively worked in a microservices‑based architecture.
Developed interactive dashboards used daily by customer success teams, reducing manual reporting time by 50%.
Built cross‑platform UI components in Flutter deployed across web and mobile, ensuring consistent UX.

projects.name: TrainMate
projects.description: A fitness platform providing schedules, workouts, diets, and transformation journeys with secure authenticated access and media uploads.
highlights: Engineered RESTful APIs for schedules, workouts, diets, and transformation journeys with Auth0 JWT‑based access control and secure session management.
Modeled data with Mongoose (users, meal logs, workout sessions, photo check‑ins) and built aggregation pipelines to surface diet and workout insights.
Implemented an AWS S3 upload flow for daily check‑ins and optimized performance via cursor‑based pagination, validation/error‑handling middleware, and rate limiting to harden endpoints.

projects.name: Warehouse Robot Path Optimization Simulator
projects.description: A warehouse simulation system for AGVs to optimize item‑picking routes using the A* algorithm with real‑time visualization.
highlights: Built a warehouse simulation system for AGVs to optimize item‑picking routes using the A* algorithm.
Designed a grid‑based Flutter UI to visualize real‑time AGV movement, collision detection, and task execution.
Implemented high‑performance pathfinding logic in C++, integrated with Flutter through FFI bindings.
Optimized multi‑robot scheduling and queued task execution, ensuring efficient and collision‑free navigation.
